workload: base-depth -m -t 32 -c 1000000; regular uncompressed TSV to a file
notes: Local incremental experiments, not a whole-genome paper rerun.
Runs are sequential; output SHA-256 is computed outside the timed command.
The HTSlib control and Seqair swap use the same binary; earlier stages use the recorded older binaries.

native_comparison.note: Two sequential runs each, reversed order on round two; no cache dropping. Input hashing precedes timing. Output hashing follows timing. Binary provenance and compiler flags must be recorded by the caller.

instrumented_diagnostics.note: Separate diagnostic binaries, not benchmark timings. Worker phase sums overlap across threads. Send timing includes channel overhead as well as blocking; writer receive includes receive overhead. Profiling added region timers and per-block channel/write timers.

provenance.rust_flags: rustc 1.98.1; -C target-cpu=native; opt-level=3; fat LTO; codegen-units=1
provenance.matched_native_flags: CC=clang (18.1.3); CFLAGS=-O3 -march=native. Applied to native C dependencies, not just libdeflate.
provenance.previous_native_compiler: GCC 13.3.0, confirmed from libdeflate object .comment before rebuild.
remaining_differences: Rust PileupAlignment measured at 44 bytes; Goose Entry generated-C stride 27 bytes. Different metadata, not identical representations.
Rust cache/window I/O policy differs from Goose current-block/read-ahead policy.
Goose decoder validates auxiliary fields and expands CG long CIGARs; Rust RecordStore path has existing CG limitation.
Both use native libdeflate 1.26, forward CIGAR cursors and SIMD-capable sequence unpacking; bounds checks exist in both.

shared_pipeline_backend_comparison.method: Same Rust binary, shared streaming pipeline; two sequential runs with reversed second-round order; hashes outside timing.

provenance.rust_build: cargo +1.98.1 build --release --features seqair --locked; RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=native; fat LTO, codegen-units=1
provenance.backend_selection: Same feature-enabled binary, with --seqair for the fork-backed path and without it for HTSlib. Both use the corrected shared scheduling/formatting/output pipeline. Feature-disabled builds retain the legacy HTSlib pipeline.
